- Cost: ballpark unit economics we discussed — can you share expected cost per 1M tokens for both hosted and a reserved Dedicated pool with quantized models?

Alex — great to meet you and the team. Quick answers and proposed next steps below (keeping this focused so procurement has what they need):

Answers (short):
- Latency: For prompts ~40 tokens we typically see p50 ~70–100ms and p95 ~240–300ms on a Dedicated (A100 class) pool with quantized weights and continuous batching tuned for your traffic. Hosted will be similar for small-scale but variability/colocated noisy neighbors can push p95 higher (~350–450ms) at peak. Private (on-prem/VPC) can meet or beat Dedicated if you provision comparable GPUs and network configuration.
- Cost (ballpark): Hosted: ~$175 per 1M tokens (mixed model with CPU/KV cache benefits). Dedicated (reserved pool, moderate commit): ~$85–120 per 1M tokens depending on instance type and utilization. Private: depends on infra amortization; we can model this once you share target QPS.
- Security docs: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report, data retention and deletion policy, and we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS & GCP KMS). See attached SOW draft that lists standard controls and timelines.

Recommended next steps:
1) I will consolidate the numbers into a short one-pager for procurement (cost range + SLA options + required lead times) — target: EOD Thu, Jun 4.
2) Marcus will define an expected p95/p50 latency matrix for your three deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private) with sample prompt profiles — target: Mon, Jun 7.
3) Procurement: please confirm who owns vendor questionnaires and whether Bluecrest requires a PO or contract redlines first.

If helpful I can also do a short technical walkthrough for Dana (CFO) to cover unit economics and commitment sizing.

Thanks,

Adding some technical context to Mina's note. Short version: achievable numbers depend on two primary knobs — batch sizing (which depends on QPS and arrival pattern) and KV/prefix cache hit rate. A few concrete data points for your planning prompts (avg 40 tokens):

- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool, RTX/A100 class, quantized int8): p50 = ~80ms, p95 = ~260ms at 300 qps sustained with 70% cache hit.
- Hosted (multi-tenant, same model family): p50 = ~120ms, p95 = ~420ms at bursty traffic; predictable at low sustained load.
- Private (on-prem with 100Gb network & equivalent GPUs): p50 = ~70ms, p95 = ~240ms assuming network and KV store tuned.

Model suggestions: recommend a quantized 7B–13B variant for best cost/latency tradeoff; we can trial small subset of your production prompts to produce an empirical per-prompt table.

I'll produce a short matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) with recommended instance families, estimated commit sizes, and expected unit cost bands by Fri, Jun 11.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
